subject: Split regional enablement + seat swap for console + API walkthrough
messages:

Subject: Quick: console + API walkthrough for NovusPay onboarding

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the trial access — the team at NovusPay would like a focused console walkthrough and an API enablement session next week so our platform and infra leads can get keys and run a quick POC. We have folks across US and EU timezones.

High level ask: 90m console walkthrough (admin+secrets, routing policies, rollout) + 60m API enablement (SDK, token usage, batching guidance). Ideally split into two shorter sessions to keep EU folks in business hours.

Attendees: Elena (platform lead), Mark Ruiz (ops), Sarah Patel (infra) + our procurement contact (sales_ops@novuspay.com).

Can you propose 3 slot options? We are on a tight timeline — aiming to start next Tue/Wed.

Thanks,
Elena
---

Platform Lead, NovusPay
elena@novuspay.com

Hi Elena — great to hear. Happy to run both sessions. To make sure we cover admin and developer needs without running late for EU folks, I suggest splitting into:

- Session A (US-focused): 90 minutes — Console deep-dive + admin runbook
- Session B (EU-friendly): 60 minutes — API enablement + SDK hands-on

Proposed slots (all in your local times, please confirm timezone):
1) Tue Nov 3 — Session A 10:00–11:30 PT / Session B 16:00–17:00 GMT
2) Wed Nov 4 — Session A 09:00–10:30 PT / Session B 15:00–16:00 GMT
3) Thu Nov 5 — Session A 11:00–12:30 PT / Session B 17:00–18:00 GMT

I'll attach a short agenda and access instructions if any of these work. Also, would you like Camila (solutions engineer) to lead the API run-through and Tessa (onboarding) to cover console admin tasks? If so, we'll draft a mutual action plan and assign pre-reqs (service account, test dataset).

Connor
